The jittering is almost like as if the bones were trying to stay stiff for half a second.

You can see that if the issue exists on hairbones and youre rotating your head, the bones will rotate with the head for a split second instead of falling down with Gravity.

I am assuming therefore that the issue is that the physbones seem to update very slowly when moved by their parent bones.

This issue doesn't require a list of effected avatar IDs.  ALL avatars with long hair, tails, any flow toys, chains anything more than like 3 physbone segments long moves with the parent now and THEN flows after.  The entire child structure moves in 3 space with the parent node and then propagtes down the chain showing nearly 0 world connectivity or momentum to move to the new location.  I've tested nearly 70 avatars now to verify this.  Just roll the change back until this is sorted in beta.  Please.
For example with allot of my avatars, example: avtr_3687dc78-7ab0-4a6f-846e-c6a6436e110f , Her flow toys are extremely jittery and spasm whenever they stand still it's just unpleasant to look at

Its really bad with the water flow-toys, like on this avi (avtr_811ca791-c444-4952-bf7a-07d134779736)

It makes me sad bc flow toys are my fav thing to dance with as an fbt with disabilities. They help me use my arms more and its very therapeutic to just watch them flow in time :( 

The jitter is so bad that unless i make very slow, LARGE movements it just jitters and snaps around. Not fun at all.

I am just testing on desktop in MMD and still noticing the same performance on the beta mine are moving smooth and only jitter during fast songs which happened before. I would make another Canny board about it as this one likely won't receive the same amount of traction anymore.
